purpose: AMD Instinct MI400-series accelerator records for large-model inference, HPC, and rack-scale AI research.

hardware.cooling: direct liquid cooling in Helios reference implementation
hardware.availability_note: AMD says MI400/Helios production shipments and volume partner deployments begin in the second half of 2026. MI455X is primarily described as the GPU used in Helios rack-scale systems rather than a retail standalone card.
research_notes: 432 GB HBM4 and 23.3 TB/s physical memory bandwidth create a materially higher single-accelerator capacity/bandwidth tier than older MI300/MI350 products.
AMD claims 34x higher token throughput than MI355X in its published Advancing AI 2026 methodology; treat this as manufacturer evidence until workload details are independently reproduced.
Do not infer board/module power from rack power or from older Instinct products; no defensible per-GPU power value was captured in this pass.

hardware.availability_note: AMD says MI430X is expected to be available in 2027 and targets sovereign AI and HPC workloads.
research_notes: MI430X emphasizes FP64/HPC while retaining very large HBM4 capacity useful for AI-for-science and large inference workloads.
Power and commercial pricing remain unpublished in the captured manufacturer material.
